req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on POST /players/ with a valid payload, a Location header pointing to the new resource, and appropriate 4xx/5xx on error paths. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a fully-populated valid payload yields 201 + correct Location + correct response body fields; (2) EP positive — minimal required-only payload (optional fields omitted) also yields 201; (3) NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409 Conflict; (4) NEG — missing required field 'first_name' yields 422; (5) NEG — missing required field 'last_name' yields 422; (6) NEG — missing required field 'squad_number' yields 422; (7) NEG — missing required field 'position' yields 422; (8) BVA — squad_number at boundary (squad 27, one above the highest pre-loaded row 26) yields 201; (9) DT — all optional fields explicitly null yields 201; (10) STC — creating then re-creating same squad_number yields 409 (state transition: non-existent -> created -> conflict). Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully-populated valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Zara', lastName='Test', squadNumber=99, position='Goalkeeper'
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201
R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Zara",
        "middleName": "Ann",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "Location" in r.headers
    assert r.headers["Location"] == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Zara"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Test"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "GK"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_create_then_duplicate_returns_409
preconditions: Database is in its pre-loaded state
Squad number 60 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=60 (first creation — should succeed with 201)
POST /players/ with squad_number=60 again (duplicate — should fail with 409)
trace: R-PLAYER-006: STC — state transition from non-existent to created (201) then to conflict (409)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_state_transition_create_then_duplicate_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 60,
        "position": "Left Winger"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r1.headers["Location"] == "/players/squadnumber/60"
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1["squadNumber"] == 60
    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert "detail" in body2

tests.name: test_post_player_response_body_contains_uuid_id_field
preconditions: Database is in its pre-loaded state
Squad number 55 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=55
Inspect the response body for the 'id' UUID field
expected: Response body contains 'id' field that is a valid UUID string
Response body firstName matches submitted value exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-006: created player response must include generated UUID id
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_response_body_contains_uuid_id_field():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "UUID",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 55,
        "position": "Attacking Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "AM",
        "team": "Test United",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    parsed = uuid.UUID(str(body["id"]))
    assert str(parsed) == str(body["id"]).lower() or body["id"] is not None
    assert body["firstName"] == "UUID"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Check"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 55
    assert body["position"] == "Attacking Midfield"
    assert body["starting11"] is False
